This is the [b]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/b] team.  [/p][p][/p][p]Our September 10 update introduces new limited-time events, along with a series of fixes for known issues and overall gameplay improvements.[/p][p] [/p][p]Dive into the full details below.[/p][p][/p][p][u][b]1️⃣ \[Improvements & Changes][/b][/u][/p][p][u][b]2️⃣ \[New Events][/b][/u][/p][p][u][b]3️⃣ \[Shop][/b][/u][/p][p][u][b]4️⃣ \[Bug Fixes][/b][/u][/p][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p][b] [/b][/p][h2][b]🛠️ IMPROVEMENTS & CHANGES[/b][/h2][h3][b] [/b][/h3][h3][b]⚜️ GENERAL[/b][/h3][p]🔸 Certain exchangeable byproducts from Ferocious Beasts, previously obtainable only in base difficulty, can now also be acquired when a World Level is applied.[/p][p]🔸 The amount of Copper obtained from certain chests in Enemy Hideouts when a World Level is applied has been increased.[/p][p]🔸 The instant progression feature for the Season 2 Pass is now available.[/p][p]     ✔️ Players can use Golden Dragons to instantly advance by the desired number of levels.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][h3][b]⚜️ COMBAT & GAMEPLAY [/b][/h3][p]🔸 A cooldown has been added to the Taunt skill used by the Ferocious Beast: Angry Bull.[/p][p]🔸 A cooldown has been added to the Dodge skill used by the Ferocious Beast: Direwolf.[/p][p]🔸 The frequency of the Charge skill used by the Ferocious Beast: Direwolf has been reduced.[/p][h3] [/h3][h3][b]⚜️ INVENTORY[/b][/h3][p]🔸 The number of default slots for Basic and Equipment inventory has been increased.[/p][p]     ✔️ Basic Inventory: 25 slots → 35 slots[/p][p]     ✔️ Equipment Inventory: 40 slots → 50 slots[/p][p]🔸 The purchase limit for Inventory Expansion Tools in the Regional Currency Exchange Shops has been increased.[/p][p]🔸 An Inventory Expansion Tool has been added to the Alliance Shop, available from Alliance Level 2 and above.[/p][p]🔸 New Basic/Equipment Inventory Expansion Tools purchasable with Golden Dragons have been added to the Support/Convenience tab within the shop. [/p][p]🔸 The maximum number of inventory slots that can be expanded using Expansion Tools has been increased.[/p][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p] [/p][h2][b]🎊 NEW EVENTS[/b][/h2][p]👉 [b]Missions Await: Claim Your Rewards in Westeros[/b][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][hr][/hr][p][b] [/b][/p][h2][b]🛒 SHOP[/b][/h2][p]🔸 New items have been added to the shop. Please check the in-game shop for more details.[/p][p]🔸 Certain items will no longer be available for purchase after September 24th. Please see below for more details.[/p][p]     ✔️ Wormwalks Challenge Conquest Package[/p][p]▸ Any unclaimed or unearned rewards will be automatically delivered to the mailbox.[/p][p]     ✔️ Westeros Welcome Package (Trial included)[/p][p]     ✔️ Mail Crow (Trial included)[/p][p]▸ Players who purchased either the Westeros Welcome Package or Mail Crow will be refunded in Iron Bank Marks.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][hr][/hr][p] [/p][h2][b]🛠️BUG FIXES[/b][/h2][p][b] [/b][/p][h3][b]⚜️ GENERAL[/b][/h3][p]🔸 Backend server optimizations have been implemented to improve overall stability.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]⚜️ COMBAT & GAMEPLAY[/b][/h3][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where the selling price of Tier 6 equipment was set the same as Tier 4 equipment.[/p][p]🔸 Fixed the spinning animation of the Giant Spider boss in Beyond the Wall Expeditions.[/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where characters could become stuck in certain terrain within the Oldtown Enemy Hideout - Shaded Septry.[/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where the Black Elk’s daze gauge was incorrectly applied in World Levels. [/p][p] [/p][h3][b]⚜️ UI/UX & VISUAL[/b][/h3][p]🔸 Implemented various UI/UX improvements.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p] [/p][p]We appreciate your continued support and feedback as we work to improve your experience in the game. As always, we remain committed to providing you with the best possible gameplay experience. Stay tuned for more updates, and thank you for being part of our community! notes.title: 8/28 Update Notes
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/661d50962b015bc14ff1bc13d0cadb05b0d26953.gif"][/img][/p][p]Greetings, Lords and Ladies. 
This is the [b]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/b] team. 

Our latest update introduces the [b]World Level System [/b]along with a new equipment tier, dungeon challenges, and a range of improvements designed to enhance your journey through Westeros.

Adjust the difficulty of the world, tackle the formidable Giant Ice Spider in the Altar of Memories, and craft powerful Tier 6 gear to strengthen your forces. Alongside these additions, we’ve made various gameplay improvements and fixes to enhance your overall experience.

Dive into the full details below.[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]1️⃣ \[New Content][/u][/b][/p][p][b][u]2️⃣ \[Improvements & Changes][/u][/b][/p][p][b][u]3️⃣\[New Events] [/u][/b][/p][p][b][u]4️⃣\[Shop][/u][/b][/p][p][b][u]5️⃣\[Bug Fixes][/u][/b][/p][p align="center"][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]
🌎 NEW CONTENT
[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]🗺️ World Level System [/b][/h3][p]🔹 The new World Level System has been added to allow players to adjust the difficulty of the game to better match their power and progression. [/p][p]🔹 You can access the World Level system via the button at the top of the [b]☰ Menu[/b]. Field content difficulty will automatically scale based on your selected level.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/3791465da8da3b4ebc25125ad00b61e63ba7b69c.png"][/img][/p][p]▸ World Level 1 & 2 have been added in this update.[/p][p][b]⚠️ Please note: A cooldown applies after changing the World Level.
[/b][/p][p][b]🔹 How To Unlock:[/b][/p][p]     ✔️ World Level 1: Complete the main quest [b]“Snow and Storm”[/b] from [b]Episode XIV - The Crow’s Bastard[/b]. [/p][p]     ✔️ World Level 2: Reach 150,000 Momentum

🔹 Repeatable content rewards now scale with the selected World Level. (One-time and first-time completion rewards remain unchanged.)[/p][p]🔹 At World Level 1,[b] Tier 6 Epic-grade[/b] materials and equipment become obtainable, while at World Level 2 and higher, [b]Tier 6 Legendary-grade[/b] materials and equipment can be acquired.[/p][p]🔹 New achievements related to World Levels have been added.[/p][p]🔹 Setting World Level 1 or higher allows all Ferocious Beast Maesters to exchange Beast Pelt Scraps.[/p][h3]
[b]⚔️ New Equipment Tier[/b][/h3][p]🔹 Tier 6 equipment has been added.[/p][p]🔹 Tier 6 gear can be crafted once you reach Forge Level 8 and Character Level 37 (Estate Level 25 required).[/p][p]🔹 The following tabs have been updated to include Tier 6: Set Research, Set Collection, Craft Equipment, and Reforge Equipment. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]🕸 Altar of Memories: Giant Ice Spider Hard Mode[/b][/h3][p]🔹 Get ready to face a new challenge! A new Hard difficulty has been added to the Altar of Memories: face off against the Frostbite Giant Ice Spider. [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]🛠️ IMPROVEMENTS & CHANGES[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]⚜️ GENERAL[/b]
[/h3][p][b]🔸 Artifact Expeditions: [/b]Rewards have been streamlined. Junk loot has been removed, and completing an expedition now grants Copper directly, without the need to sell items separately.[/p][p][/p][p][b]🔸 Altar of Memories Rankings Rewards: [/b]With the introduction of the new Hard difficulty in the Altar of Memories, ranking rewards have been adjusted:[/p][p]    ✔️ The rewards previously tied to the former top difficulty, Stormshower Plains – Stormhorn Unicorn, have been shifted to the new top-tier challenge, Frostbite - Giant Ice Spider.[/p][p]    ✔️ This adjustment applies to all non-equipment rewards. Tiered equipment rewards remain specific to each dungeon.[/p][p]    ✔️ Lower-difficulty dungeons have also been adjusted, with their rewards moved up one tier to match the next-highest difficulty.[/p][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][th][p align="center"][b]Altar of Memories[/b][/p][/th][th][p align="center"][b]Ranking Rewards[/b][/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p align="center"]Shores of Dorne - Blue Cockatrice[/p][/td][td][p align="center"][b]Removed[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p align="center"]Frozen Cave - Giant Ice Spider[/p][/td][td][p align="center"][b]Removed[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p align="center"]Valley of Gold - Ironbeak Griffin[/p][/td][td][p align="center"]Changed[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p align="center"]Shores of Dorne - Cockatrices[/p][/td][td][p align="center"]Changed[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p align="center"]Stormshower Plains - Stormhorn Unicorn[/p][/td][td][p align="center"]Changed[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p align="center"]Frostbite - Giant Ice Spider[/p][/td][td][p align="center"][b]New[/b][/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p][b]🍰 [/b]A new time-limited buff item [b]100 Days Celebration Cake[/b] has been added, which applies the following effects for 30 minutes upon use:[/p][p]🔹 Attack Power +10%[/p][p]🔹 Critical Strike Damage +10%[/p][p]🔹 Rage Consumption -15%[/p][p]▸ This item can be obtained through events held in celebration of the 100-day milestone.[/p][p][/p][p]🔸 The difficulty of certain Guidebook missions, including Side Quests, the Altar of Memories, and selected Field Content, has been reduced to ensure a smoother progression experience.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]🎊 NEW EVENTS[/b][/h2][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/games/3183280/announcements/detail/536611691635409323?snr=2___"]👉 100 Days of Kingsroad: Special Events[/url][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]🛒 SHOP[/b][/h2][p]🔸New items have been added to the shop. Please check the in-game shop for more details.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]🛠️BUG FIXES[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]⚜️ GENERAL[/b][/h3][p]🔸 Backend server optimizations have been implemented to improve overall stability.
[/p][h3][b]⚜️ COMBAT & GAMEPLAY[/b][/h3][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where characters could occasionally fall off cliffs in certain Beyond the Wall Expedition stages.[/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue in Altar of Lost Memories - Kraken where ink projectiles disappeared before hitting the ground.[/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where World Boss Black Shadow Drogon could sometimes freeze during combat. [/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where World Boss Black Shadow Drogon could become immune to damage for a period of time under certain conditions. [/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where some effects of the Assassin’s Strike Combo IV Mastery: Elimination did not trigger correctly. [/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where the damage of the Assassin’s Dagger Throw skill did not increase properly when leveled up. [/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where the defeating the Elite Solder in the Enemy Hideout “Woods Fortress” did not count towards the mission under certain conditions. [/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue that prevented the completion of the Enemy Hideout “Raven’s Rock Fortress” under certain conditions. 
[/p][h3][b]⚜️ QUESTS & NPCS[/b][/h3][p]🔸 Added additional unskippable dialogue lines in cutscenes for the seasonal side quests “The Crown of Love and Death” and “Prisoner of the Iron Islands.”[/p][p]🔸 Fixed unnatural NPC movements during the tournament sequence in the seasonal side quest “The Crown of Love and Death.”[/p][p]🔸 Fixed collision issues when using the Follow Path feature.[/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where certain enemies in the North’s Enemy Hideout “Coastal Fortress” could move outside the intended area. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]⚜️ CONTROL & INPUT [/b][/h3][p]🔸 Added fences and adjusted terrain on select bridges in Brightwater Keep to prevent frequent falls.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]⚜️ UI/UX & VISUAL [/b][/h3][p]🔸 Implemented various UI/UX improvements.[/p][p]🔸 Updated certain quest dialogue for clarity.[/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where wild animals could occasionally spawn beneath the terrain.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p] [/p][p]We appreciate your continued support and feedback as we work to improve your experience in the game. As always, we remain committed to providing you with the best possible gameplay experience. Stay tuned for more updates, and thank you for being part of our community!  [/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/5ed36ee26b1ff3db583fb8abcaf82146b8ca8f7e.jpg"][/img]
[/p]

notes.title: Upcoming Update Preview
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/b12f21ba30e92bbd6503cb8c881325f8f31f2348.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Greetings, Lords and Ladies.[/p][p]This is the [b]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad [/b]team.[/p][p] [/p][p]Today, we’d like to give our players a [b]sneak peek at the upcoming content[/b] that will be added during Season 2: Highgarden Grand Festival.[/p][p] [/p][p]Check out the details below to get a glimpse of what’s in store. From fresh challenges to engaging new adventures, there’s plenty to look forward to, and we hope you’re as excited as we are to experience everything Season 2 has to offer![/p][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p] [/p][h3][b]🌍 World Level System[/b][/h3][h3] [/h3][p]To provide players with greater challenges and a stronger sense of accomplishment, we are introducing the [b]World Level System[/b].[/p][p] [/p][p]This system is designed to[b] elevate the difficulty and rewards[/b] of repeatable content across the entire open world, bringing a new sense of excitement and tension into environments you’ve already grown familiar with.[/p][p] [/p][p]With the World Level System, all repeatable content in the open world will scale according to the selected level. The world will automatically adjust to match this level, ensuring that every encounter reflects the challenge you’ve chosen.[/p][p][i]🚨 Please note that rewards from one-time rewards will not scale.[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]Players will unlock the World Level system after completing the final quest currently available in the main story (Stormlands - Crow’s Nest) and certain stages of the Wormwalks Challenge. When entering a World Level, both content difficulty and rewards will scale accordingly.[/p][p] [/p][p]This update will introduce World Levels 1 and 2, offering tougher enemies and a higher level of challenge for players ready to test their skills.[/p][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p] [/p][h3][b]🏰 Altar of Memories – Hard Difficulty[/b][/h3][p] [/p][p]With the introduction of the World Level System, a new Hard Difficulty is coming to the Altar of Memories.[/p][p] [/p][p]The first boss players will face on Hard Difficulty is the Giant Ice Spider. Its appearance is far more menacing, and it now wields stronger, more unpredictable skills that push players beyond the challenges of the normal version.[/p][p] [/p][p]Defeating the Giant Ice Spider on Hard Difficulty will reward[b] new tier equipment[/b], giving you every reason to prepare for these intense and strategic battles. Sharpen your skills and get ready to face a tougher, more formidable foe than before.[/p][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p] [/p][h3][b]🛡️ Tier 6 Equipment[/b][/h3][p] [/p][p]Higher-tier rewards will also be available as another part of the new World Level System.[/p][p] [/p][p]At World Level 1, players will be able to obtain materials for Tier 6 equipment. These materials are not limited to specific Ferocious Beasts. [b]All Ferocious Beasts at this level will drop Tier 6 crafting materials[/b], and you will be able to challenge any beast at this level to collect them.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Tier 6 equipment will be craftable once your character reaches level 37 and your Estate reaches level 25, which allows you to upgrade your Forge to level 8.[/b] All Ferocious Beast byproducts will be exchangeable while in World Level 1 and above.[/p][p] [/p][p]Players will be able to use World Level content to collect these materials and craft the new Tier 6 equipment, preparing themselves for even more challenging adventures ahead.[/p][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p] [/p][p]This update is only the beginning for World Level content.[/p][p] [/p][p]We are already preparing even more diverse World Level experiences for future seasons, and detailed information will be shared in an upcoming Developer Note later this month.[/p][p] [/p][p]We hope you’ll stay excited as we continue expanding World Level content and introducing new additions to enhance your adventures.[/p][p] [/p][p]Thank you for being part of our growing world.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/5ed36ee26b1ff3db583fb8abcaf82146b8ca8f7e.jpg"][/img][/p][p]	[/p]

notes.title: Celebrate the Highgarden Grand Festival Update with Login Rewards!

notes.title: 8/7 Update Notes [Updated on 8/7 02:45 PT]
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/661d50962b015bc14ff1bc13d0cadb05b0d26953.gif"][/img][/p][p]Greetings, Lords and Ladies.
This is the [b]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad [/b]team.[/p][p] [/p][p]Our latest update ushers in [b]Season 2: Highgarden Grand Festival[/b], bringing fresh adventures and exciting new content to Westeros.[/p][p]
Join the celebration with brand-new seasonal quests, bounties, and a brand-new Season Pass featuring exclusive rewards, including the coveted Laurels of Victory weapon skin.[/p][p][/p][p]Season 2 also expands Beyond the Wall Expeditions and Wormwalks with unique seasonal mechanics, while improvements to skills, artifacts, and gameplay balance ensure a more thrilling experience for all players.
[/p][p]Additionally, we’ve included a variety of system enhancements and bug fixes to smooth your journey through the realm.
[/p][p]Dive into the full details below.[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]1️⃣ \[New Content][/u][/b][/p][p][b][u]2️⃣ \[Improvements & Changes][/u][/b][/p][p][b][u]3️⃣\[New Events] [/u][/b][/p][p][b][u]4️⃣\[Shop][/u][/b][/p][p][b][u]5️⃣\[Bug Fixes][/u][/b][/p][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]🍷 NEW CONTENT[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]🌸 Season 2: Highgarden Grand Festival[/b][/h3][p]♦️ Season 2: Highgarden Grand Festival officially begins. [/p][p]     ✔️ The new seasonal content is available after completing the main quest [b]“Report to Lord Roose Bolton”[/b]. [/p][p]     ✔️ The new seasonal quests and bounties are available after completing the main quest [b]“Talk to Maester Seymour”[/b] in Highgarden. [/p][p]♦️ A brand new Season Pass is now available. [/p][p]♦️ Clearing seasonal content will allow you to progress Season Pass missions, and increase your pass level, unlocking exclusive seasonal progression elements along the way. [/p][p]♦️ Reach the final tier of the Season Pass to unlock the new exclusive [b]Laurels of Victory Weapon Skin[/b]. [/p][p]     ✔️ The  weapon skin can be equipped via Equipment ➜ Wardrobe. [/p][p]     ✔️ After reaching the final Season Pass tier, additional versions of the weapon skin for other classes can be purchased from the shop. [/p][p]♦️ Two new side quests (The Citadel’s Lost Giant & The Crown of Love and Death) and bounties themed around “Highgarden Grand Festival” are available. [/p][p]♦️ The quest “The Crown of Love and Death” will become available after completing “The Citadel’s Lost Giant”. [/p][p]♦️ Beyond the Wall Expeditions and seasonal Wormwalks have been updated for Season 2. [/p][p][/p][p]📢 The world level system, previously announced in the most recent developer note, will be added in an update in the near future along with tier 6 equipment and a Hard difficulty for Altar of Memories - Giant Ice Spider. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]🌹 Seasonal Content & Exclusive Effects \[Updated on 8/7 02:45 PT][/b][/h3][p]♦️ The seasonal Beyond the Wall Expeditions and Wormwalks feature exclusive seasonal mechanics. [/p][p]♦️ Participating in these seasonal activities does not consume RP, but instead uses a separate pool of reward attempts. [/p][p]♦️ When progressing through Seasonal Beyond the Wall Expeditions and Seasonal Wormwalks, the season-exclusive effect [b]Trial of Fervor[/b] will be active, along with the Fervor Gauge. [/p][p]▸ These seasonal effects or traits do not apply to the original Wormwalks stages. [/p][p][b]     ✔️ Trial Gauge: [/b]The Trial Gauge gradually fills whenever certain conditions are met. Once the gauge reaches certain thresholds, you will suffer significant damage and harmful effects. The conditions for charging the Trial Gauge differ between Beyond the Wall Expeditions and Wormwalks. 
[b]     ✔️ Seasonal Beyond the Wall Expedition: [/b]Fervor gradually builds up when taking damage from enemies. 
[b]     ✔️ Seasonal Wormwalks: [/b]Fervor gradually builds up over time during combat or when taking damage. [/p][p]▸ Gaining a barrier instantly removes all active Trial of Fervor debuffs. While the barrier is active, you are immune to the harmful effects of the Trial Gauge.[/p][p]♦️ Season Growth Points earned from the Season Pass can be used to enhance traits specific to Seasonal Beyond the Wall Expeditions and Seasonal Wormwalks.[/p][p]♦️ Rankings have been added for Season 2 of Beyond the Wall Expeditions and Wormwalks. [/p][p]     ✔️ Each set of rankings includes a weekly ranking, calculated and rewarded every week, and a final ranking, determined based on performance across the entire season.
[/p][p][b]📢 Clear rewards will be provided based on the number of Beyond the Wall Expedition tickets owned prior to the maintenance on August 6th. [/b]
[/p][h3][b]🏺New Artifacts[/b][/h3][p]🔹3 new Artifacts have been added.[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,"][tr][th][p][b]Grade[/b][/p][/th][th][p][b]Name[/b][/p][/th][th][p][b]Type[/b][/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p]Rare[/p][/td][td][p]Bronze Harpy Statue[/p][/td][td][p]Active[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Epic[/p][/td][td][p]Laughing Tree’s Tattered Cloth[/p][/td][td][p]Passive[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Legendary[/p][/td][td][p]Crown of Winter Roses[/p][/td][td][p]Active[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][h3]➕ [b]Content Expansion[/b][/h3][p]♦️ Wormwalks Challenge has been expanded from stage 50 ➜ 55. [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]🛠️ IMPROVEMENTS & CHANGES[/b][/h2][h3][b]
⚜️ GENERAL[/b][/h3][p]🔸 A leaderboard for Wormwalks Challenge has been added. [/p][p]▸ Please note that these rankings do not have rewards. [/p][p]🔸 You can now use any jewelry of the same grade and slot as material when recasting, rather than being limited to identical pieces.[/p][p]     ✔️ You can still use identical jewelry when recasting, which reduces the number of materials needed compared to using other different pieces.[/p][p]🔸 The maximum recast level for legendary jewelry has been increased from 5 ➜ 7. [/p][p]🔸 Added support for DualSense and other controllers on mobile devices. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]⚜️ SKILLS[/b][/h3][p]🔸 Certain skills have been grouped together. [/p][p]🔸 When you level up one skill in a group, all skills within that group will level up simultaneously. [/p][p]     ✔️ The skill point cost for leveling up a grouped skill remains the same as before, with no additional points spent. [/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][th][p][b]Before[/b][/p][/th][th][p][b]After[/b][/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p]✔ Strike Combo I[/p][p]✔ Strike Combo II[/p][p]✔ Strike Combo III[/p][p]✔ Strike Combo IV[/p][/td][td][p]Strike Combo[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]✔ Evasion Attack [/p][p]✔ Sprint Attack (Light)
✔ Sprint Attack (Heavy)[/p][/td][td][p]Moving Attack[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]✔ Sneak Attack [/p][p]✔ Mighty Strike[/p][p]✔ Parry-linked Attack[/p][/td][td][p]Special Attack[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p]📢 [b]Please note that as a result of the skill grouping changes, all skill and mastery levels will be reset upon your first login after the update. Please be sure to re-allocate your skill and mastery points. [/b][/p][p]🔸 The naming convention for + Skill Effects obtained through refinement has been changed. [/p][p]    ✔️ For example: Merciless Strike + ➜ Merciless Strike (Enhanced)[/p][p][/p][h3][b]⚜️ BALANCE ADJUSTMENTS[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][b]🗡️ KNIGHT[/b][/p][p]🔸 Damage from the first two hits from Strike Combo IV has been increased. [/p][p]🔸 The skill effect and cooldown for Boost Morale & Boost Morale (Enhanced) have been adjusted. [/p][p]    ✔️ Damage Taken Reduction: 25 - 37.5% ➜ Active Skill Damage Increase: 20%[/p][p]    ✔️ Cooldown: 30 seconds ➜ 24 seconds[/p][p][/p][p][b]🪓 SELLSWORD[/b][/p][p]🔸 Damage from the first two hits from Strike Combo III has been increased. [/p][p]🔸 Damage from the first three hits from Strike Combo IV has been increased. [/p][p]🔸 The cooldown and effect duration of the Roar & Roar (Enhanced) skill have been adjusted. [/p][p]    ✔️ Cooldown: 30 seconds ➜ 24 seconds[/p][p]    ✔️ Damage Increase effect duration increased (8 seconds ➜ 12 seconds).[/p][p]    ✔️ Berserk Reforge Effect duration increased (8 seconds ➜ 12 seconds).[/p][p]    ✔️ Vitality Reforge Effect duration increased (8 seconds ➜ 12 seconds).[/p][p]🔸 The duration of the Rampage skill has been increased to 12 seconds. [/p][p]🔸 The duration of the Defense Decrease effect on enemies from Rampage (Enhanced) has been increased (10 seconds ➜ 12 seconds).[/p][p][/p][p]⚔️ [b]ASSASSIN[/b][/p][p]🔸 Damage from the first three hits from Strike Combo III has been increased. [/p][p]🔸 Damage from the first three hits from Strike Combo IV has been increased. [/p][p]🔸 The Bloodburst effect stacks are no longer shared with other characters. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]⚜️ OTHER[/b][/h3][p]🔸 The maximum number of normal enemies that can be stunned by Legendary Artifacts has been increased (4 ➜ 10).[/p][p]🔸 The buff radius for Active Artifact Skills that can affect party members has been significantly increased. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]🤝 ALLIANCE[/b][/h3][p]🔸 Alliance missions have been revamped. [/p][p]    ✔️ Alliance Mission Chance Recharge Ticket items have been removed. In exchange, Alliance Coins will be granted based on your Alliance Level as shown below.[/p][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][th][p][b]Alliance Level[/b][/p][/th][th][p][b]Distributed Alliance Coins[/b][/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p]1-4[/p][/td][td][p]0[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]5-9[/p][/td][td][p]750[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]10-14[/p][/td][td][p]1,500[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]15-19[/p][/td][td][p]3,000[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]20+[/p][/td][td][p]5,200[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p]🔸 Personal Missions are now divided into daily and weekly missions. [/p][p]    ✔️ Daily missions can be completed once per day, while weekly missions can be completed once per week. [/p][p]🔸 The alliance check-in missions have been removed from Guidebook > Daily Missions. [/p][p]🔸 Guidebook > Weekly missions have been adjusted, with improved rewards for the final stage. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]❄️ SEASON 1 CHANGES[/b][/h3][p]🔸 Season 1 bounties will remain accessible even after the end of season 1. [/p][p][b]   ✔️ Winterfell Bounties: [/b]Smudge & Black Manta[/p][p][b]   ✔️ Prerequisites: [/b]You must have completed the Winterfell Main Quest “The North Remembers” and side quest “Order of Wolves”. [/p][p]🔸 Season 1 field monsters have been removed, and the item “\[Season] Ironborn's Loot” will no longer drop. [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]

notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/661d50962b015bc14ff1bc13d0cadb05b0d26953.gif"][/img]
[/p][p]Greetings, Lords and Ladies. 
This is the [b]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/b] team. 

Our July 9 update introduces new limited-time events, along with a series of fixes for known issues and overall gameplay improvements.[/p][p][/p][p]Please refer to the details below for more information.[/p][p][/p][p]1️⃣\[Improvements & Changes][/p][p]2️⃣\[New Events] [/p][p]3️⃣\[Bug Fixes][/p][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]🛠️ IMPROVEMENTS & CHANGES[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]⚜️GENERAL[/b][/h3][p]🔸 Items can now be purchased in the shop for up to a maximum of 100 per purchase. [/p][p]The maximum quantity for bundle purchases in the shop has been increased from 30 to 100 per purchase. [/p][p]🔸 Kraken Amulet Designs can now be used in bulk.[/p][p]🔸 The blacksmith in Crow’s Nest now crafts equipment with Shadowcat Leather instead of Boar Leather. [/p][p]🔸 The cost to reset the Season Trait Tree has been reduced from 1,000 Copper to 100 Copper. [/p][p]🔸 The rankings for the previous Beyond the Wall Expeditions, which were marked as (Ending Soon), have now been removed. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]⚜️REWARDS [/b][/h3][p]🔸 The rewards for Black Shadow Drogon have been adjusted. [/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,,"][tr][th][p][b]Rank[/b][/p][/th][th][p][b]Jewelry Polish[/b][/p][/th][th][p][b]Gemstone[/b][/p][/th][th][p][b]Copper[/b][/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p]1st[/p][/td][td][p]9 > [b]12[/b][/p][/td][td][p]15 > [b]20[/b][/p][/td][td][p]6,000 > [b]7,800[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]2nd/3rd[/p][/td][td][p]7 > [b]8[/b][/p][/td][td][p]9 > [b]17[/b][/p][/td][td][p]5,000 > [b]6,600[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Others[/p][/td][td][p]7 > [b]8[/b][/p][/td][td][p]7 > [b]14[/b][/p][/td][td][p]4,000 > [b]5,400[/b][/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p]🔸 The exchange limit for the following items in the Shadowcat Parts Exchange Shop has been increased:[/p][p][b]   ✔️ Legendary Equipment Selection Box: [/b]1 ➜ 2[/p][p][b]   ✔️ Copper: [/b]5 ➜ 15[/p][p][b]   ✔️ Equipment Hardener: [/b]2[b] [/b]➜ 6[/p][p]🔸 Items acquired from Ferocious Beasts can no longer be discarded. [/p][p]▸ Further information will be provided at a later date for players who obtained Shadowcat materials prior to the update but discarded them.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]⚜️BALANCE[/b][/h3][p]🔸 The Dragon Hunter enemy that spawns in the Bandit Camp “Dragon’s Hunter Rest” in Crow’s Nest has been downgraded from Boss to Elite, and his HP has been reduced. [/p][p]🔸 The number of enemies that appear in the Crow’s Nest Enemy Hideout “Raven’s Rock Fortress” has been reduced. [/p][p]▸ This adjustment was made to reduce combat difficulty due to high enemy density. [/p][p]▸ While the total number of enemies has been decreased, EXP and Copper rewards from the remaining enemies have been increased to ensure that total gains are not negatively impacted. [/p][p]🔸 The Boss-grade enemy appearing in “Raven’s Rock Fortress” now grants increased EXP and Copper upon defeat. [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]🎊 NEW EVENTS[/b][/h2][p][b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3183280/view/536605983645897221"]👉 7/9 Events: Master of Steel & March of Glory[/url][/b][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]🛠️BUG FIXES[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]⚜️GENERAL[/b][/h3][p]🔸 Backend server optimizations have been implemented to improve overall stability.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]⚜️COMBAT & GAMEPLAY [/b][/h3][p][/p][p][b]🔸 Historic Site: Witch of the Forest[/b][/p][p]   ✔️ Fixed an issue where Historic Site: Witch of the Forest could not be completed as intended. [/p][p]   ✔️ Fixed an issue where players could die under certain conditions in Historic Site: Witch of the Forest. [/p][p][b]   ✔️ [/b]Fixed an issue where falling into water during Historic Site: Witch of the Forest would not result in character death. [/p][p][/p][p][b]🔸 Occupied Site: Griffin’s Cove[/b][/p][p]   ✔️ Fixed an issue where players could get stuck in terrain during battle in Occupied Sites: Griffin’s Cove. [/p][p]   ✔️ Fixed an issue where ladders could not be used correctly while clearing Occupied Site: Griffin’s Cove. [/p][p]   ✔️ Fixed an issue where certain quests in Occupied Site: Griffin’s Cove could be cleared without being accepted under certain conditions. [/p][p][/p][p][b]🔸 Enemy Hideout: Raven’s Rock Fortress[/b][/p][p]   ✔️ Fixed an issue where players could get stuck in terrain within Enemy Hideout: Raven’s Rock Fortress. [/p][p]   ✔️ Adjusted the placement of some enemies within Enemy Hideout: Raven’s Rock Fortress. [/p][p]   ✔️ Fixed an issue where NPCs tied to a mission objective would remain spawned on the map after clearing Enemy Hideout: Raven’s Rock Fortress. [/p][p][/p][p][b]🔸 Wormwalks[/b][/p][p]   ✔️ Fixed an issue where the “Kill enemies with ranged attacks” objective could not be cleared under certain conditions in Wormwalks. [/p][p]   ✔️ Fixed an issue where the knockdown animation was not triggered upon being hit by “Lightning Strike” while clearing Wormwalks. [/p][p]   ✔️ Fixed an issue where rewards were not received under certain conditions upon clearing Seasonal Wormwalks. [/p][p][/p][p][b]🔸 Beyond the Wall Expeditions[/b][/p][p]   ✔️ Fixed an issue where attacks on the initial group of wolves within the “Clear Wolf Den” mission in Beyond the Wall Expeditions made it difficult to proceed with the quest. [/p][p]   ✔️ Fixed an issue where Wolf Leader enemies in Beyond the Wall Expeditions were not properly affected by hitstun effects. [/p][p][/p][p][b]🔸 Kraken Raid[/b][/p][p]   ✔️ Fixed an issue during the final phase of Kraken Raid where both the tentacles and main body could still be damaged after the boss was defeated. [/p][p]   ✔️ Adjusted Kraken Raid so that if the boss’s HP is reset mid-fight, any damage dealt prior to the reset is no longer counted toward the rankings.[/p][p]   ✔️ Fixed an issue where the post-defeat cutscene for the Kraken Raid would cause the raid to fail if it did not end within the clear time. [/p][p][/p][p][b]🔸 Other[/b][/p][p]  ✔️ Alliance effects will no longer be removed upon death. [/p][p]  ✔️ Fixed an issue where trading rewards from Griffin’s Cove provided items with an unusually low sale value. [/p][p]  ✔️ Removed the level requirement when exchanging Intact Shadowcat Leather Scraps. [/p][p]  ✔️ Fixed an issue where World Boss Drogon would target and cast skills on recently resurrected players. [/p][p]  ✔️ Fixed an issue where the “Balance” House Sigil Board would occasionally not unlock even after meeting the required conditions. [/p][p]  ✔️ Fixed an issue where HP Tinctures would occasionally not be consumed when used under certain conditions. [/p][p]  ✔️ Fixed an issue where the Merciless Strike+ skill (Sellsword class) could be used repeatedly without consuming Rage after triggering the first hit. [/p][p]  ✔️ Fixed an issue where an error message would occasionally appear during matchmaking for Altar of Memories, preventing the player from being matched to a party. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]⚜️ QUESTS & NPCS[/b][/h3][p]🔸 Fixed an issue in the seasonal side quest “Prisoner of the Iron Islands” where the Research Log could be obtained multiple times. [/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue in the seasonal side quest “Prisoner of the Iron Islands” where rapidly defeating the Ironborn that appeared in the Tallhart Port ship after inspecting the caged prisoner blocked quest progress. [/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue in the main quest in Crow’s Nest where a barrier spawned too early during the boss fight, preventing entry. [/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue that prevented traveling to other areas if the main-quest boss in Crow’s Nest was left undefeated. [/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where respawning during quests in Crow’s Nest could incorrectly place the character at the lighthouse. [/p][p]🔸 Adjusted the positions of certain NPCs and wildlife in Crow’s Nest. [/p][p]🔸 Adjusted spawn locations for certain Peddlers. [/p][p]🔸 Fixed missing dialogue lines in certain side quests. [/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where a Riddle quest was displayed upon every login.[/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where “The Wolves in the Woods” quest could not be progressed under certain conditions. [/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where crafting a Legendary-grade item did not count towards completing the Guidebook Mission 5-10: Craft Epic or better equipment. 
[/p][h3][b]⚜️CONTROL & INPUT [/b][/h3][h3]🔸 Adjusted the location of Raven’s Rock Signpost in Crow’s Nest. [/h3][p]🔸 Adjusted the location of the broken signpost for Bitterleaf Ledge in Crow’s Nest. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]⚜️ UI/UX & VISUAL [/b][/h3][p]🔸 Overall improvements to UI/UX have been implemented. [/p][p]🔸 Fixed various in-game typos. [/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where some in-game text was either missing or displayed in an incorrect language.[/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where certain environmental or gathering objects appeared to be floating. [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p] [/p][p]We appreciate your continued support and feedback as we work to improve your experience in the game. As always, we remain committed to providing you with the best possible gameplay experience. Stay tuned for more updates, and thank you for being part of our community!  [/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/5ed36ee26b1ff3db583fb8abcaf82146b8ca8f7e.jpg"][/img]

notes.title: 6/26 Update Notes
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/661d50962b015bc14ff1bc13d0cadb05b0d26953.gif"][/img][/p][p]Greetings, Lords and Ladies.[/p][p]This is the [b]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad [/b]team.[/p][p] [/p][p]Our June 26 update brings the first major content drop since launch, and with it, the arrival of [b]Season 1: The Drowned God Wakes[/b].[/p][p] [/p][p]This new season introduces the Kraken Raid, where a powerful new enemy and valuable rewards await. The newly added Amulet system also brings fresh ways to enhance your strength and customize your build.[/p][p]  [/p][p]A new difficulty level for World Boss Drogon has also been added, offering a greater challenge for seasoned players alongside a host of new content. This update also brings limited-time seasonal events, a range of system improvements, and a round of bug fixes for known issues.[/p][p] [/p][p]Check out the full details below.[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]1️⃣ New Content[/u][/b][/p][p][b][u]2️⃣ Improvements & Changes[/u][/b][/p][p][b][u]3️⃣New Events[/u][/b][/p][p][b][u]4️⃣Shop[/u][/b][/p][p][b][u]5️⃣Bug Fixes[/u][/b][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]🛡️ NEW CONTENT[/b][/h2][p][b] [/b][/p][h3][b]⚔️ Season 1: The Drowned God Wakes[/b][/h3][p]🔹Season 1: The Drowned God Wakes officially begins.[/p][p]▸ The new season is available after completing the main quest [b]Report to Lord Roose Bolton[/b].[/p][p]🔹Clearing seasonal content will advance Season Pass missions. As the pass level increases, you can unlock exclusive seasonal progression elements along the way.[/p][p]🔹A brand-new season pass is now available.[/p][p]🔹Reach the final tier of the season pass to unlock the exclusive [b]Krakencoil Weapon Skin[/b].[/p][p]     ✔️ The weapon skin can be equipped through [b]Equipment ➜ Wardrobe[/b].[/p][p]     ✔️ After reaching the final season pass tier, additional versions of the Krakencoil weapon skin for other classes can be purchased from the shop.[/p][p]🔹New side quests and bounties themed around “The Drowned God Wakes” are available.[/p][p]     ✔️ These side quests and bounties will remain accessible even after the season ends.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][h3][b]❄️ Seasonal Beyond the Wall Expeditions[/b][/h3][p]🔹The previous Beyond the Wall Expedition has been revamped into the seasonal Beyond the Wall Expedition.[/p][p]    ✔️ Ranking rewards for the original Beyond the Wall Expeditions will be calculated based on standings just before the Season 1 update, and will be distributed sequentially starting July 1st (PT).[/p][p]🔹Several of the original Beyond the Wall Expedition effects have been adjusted or removed, and the related shop items have been reworked.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][h3][b]❄️ Seasonal Wormwalks[/b][/h3][p]🔹A seasonal version of Wormwalks has been added, available alongside the original Wormwalks content.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][h3][b]❄️ Seasonal Content & Effects[/b][/h3][p]🔹The seasonal Beyond the Wall Expeditions and Wormwalks feature exclusive seasonal mechanics.[/p][p]🔹Participating in these seasonal activities does not consume RP, but instead uses a separate pool of reward attempts.[/p][p]🔹When progressing through Seasonal Beyond the Wall Expeditions and Seasonal Wormwalks, the season-exclusive effect [b]Trial of Steel[/b] will be active, along with two new gauges: [b]Heat [/b]and [b]Erosion[/b].[/p][p]▸ These seasonal effects or traits do not apply to the original Wormwalks stages.[/p][p]     ✔️ [b]Heat Gauge: [/b]Builds up upon landing Active Skills on enemies, granting buffs that aid combat based on its accumulation.[/p][p]     ✔️ [b]Erosion Gauge: [/b]Builds up upon landing Strike Combos on enemies or when damage is taken, applying debuffs that hinder combat effectiveness as it accumulates.[/p][p]🔹Beyond the Wall Expedition Season Growth Points & Wormwalks Season Growth Points earned through the Season Pass can be used to enhance traits related to Seasonal Beyond the Wall Expeditions and Seasonal Wormwalks.[/p][p]🔹New rankings have been added for Seasonal Greetings, Lords and Ladies. 
This is the [b]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/b] team. 

Thank you for joining us on this epic journey with the official launch of [i]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/i]. As we settle into this new era, our team is committed to ensuring a smooth and enjoyable experience for everyone.

This patch focuses on resolving a number of known issues and includes some quality-of-life improvements.

You can find the full list of changes below.

[b]1️⃣ [New Events]
2️⃣ [Adjustments & Bug Fixes] [/b]


[h2][b]🎊 NEW EVENTS[/b][/h2]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3183280/view/536604072953774199][Go to Events][/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/3183280/announcements/detail/536602812925083836?snr=2___][New Trial Race & Bonus Time Events][/url]


[h2][b]🛠️ ADJUSTMENTS & BUG FIXES[/b][/h2]
 
[h3][b]⚜️ GENERAL[/b][/h3]
🔸Backend server optimizations have been implemented to improve overall stability.

[h3][b]⚖️ BALANCE ADJUSTMENTS[/b][/h3]
The Assassin class skill [Agile Movement] was previously causing an unintended large reduction to the enemy’s Daze gauge in a single hit. This issue has now been fixed with an appropriate adjustment to the skill.

🔸The Daze damage dealt by the enhanced evasion attack after using the Assassin’s [Agile Movement] skill has been adjusted.
🔸The Hitstun effect applied to enemies by the Assassin’s enhanced evasion attack after using [Agile Movement] has been removed.

[h3][b]⚔️ COMBAT & GAMEPLAY[/b][/h3]
🔸Fixed an issue where the associated Momentum did not increase accordingly when leveling up certain skills past a certain threshold.
🔸Fixed an issue where players were unable to move during the main quest [Travel to Last Hearth].
🔸Fixed an issue where using the escape function in Last Hearth’s Multi Space area caused characters to become stuck in terrain.
🔸Fixed an issue where attempting to create an Alliance with an already existing name would display a [Logic Error] message.
🔸Fixed an issue where resetting the Trait Tree under certain conditions could cause associated Skill Points to be lost.
▸ Lost Skill Points due to this issue will be sequentially returned after June 4, 01:00 AM (PT).
🔸Fixed an issue where RP would occasionally not recharge after logging out of the game for a period of time.
🔸Fixed an issue where Trading Routes for certain regions occasionally did not unlock despite meeting all conditions.
🔸Rewards obtained from defeating wildlife near the [Secluded Hut] Bandit Camp in the Stormlands have been changed.
🔸Fixed an issue where the Attack Speed Increase stat was not being applied properly.
🔸Fixed an issue where the Red Cockatrice’s attacks in the Altar of Memories dungeon did not apply the intended Attack Speed Decrease effect.
🔸Fixed an issue during Beyond the Wall Expedition where the Attack Speed Decrease effect based on the Cold Gauge was not applied.
🔸Fixed an issue in [Explore cliff paths] in Beyond the Wall Expedition where the tree could not be cut down, preventing progress.
🔸Fixed an issue in which [Bandit Camp in the Gift] could not be cleared under certain conditions.
🔸Adjusted the push notification frequency for Production, Trade, and Relic Expedition activities.
🔸Fixed an issue where the weekly mission [Defeat World Bosses] could not be cleared properly.
🔸Fixed an issue where the quest information was not displayed properly when reconnecting to the game in the World Boss Drogon area.
🔸Fixed a visual issue where the Boar Territory Signpost was not displayed in the Storm’s End Exploration Progress.
🔸Fixed an issue where players could not receive rewards upon clearing Wormwalks with a full inventory.

[h3][b]🛒 SHOP[/b][/h3]
🔸New items have been added to the shop.
🔸Fixed an issue where tapping on the Joffrey’s Outfit in the Suggested tab did not bring up the purchase pop-up.

[h3][b]⚜️ QUESTS & NPCS[/b][/h3]
🔸Fixed an issue where the stats for Elite enemies encountered during the side quest [Blood in the Water] in Storm’s End were incorrectly low.
🔸Fixed an issue preventing players from leaving the quest area during the main quest [Forbidden Knowledge].
🔸Fixed an issue where the Peddler would occasionally fail to appear in the Stormlands.
🔸Fixed an issue where the chest could not be interacted with during the Stormlands side quest [Nowhere to Return To].
🔸Fixed an issue where progress could be occasionally blocked during the main quest [Allies of the North].
🔸Fixed an issue where there was a delay in door interactions during the side quest [The Men of Kings and Queens].
🔸Fixed an issue where Elite Enemy kills were not being properly counted in certain Enemy Hideouts.
🔸Fixed an issue where players could occasionally get stuck in terrain, preventing them from moving during the main quest [Red Priest].
🔸Fixed an issue during the side quest [The Attack on Knifesbend] where a black screen would appear at the start of combat.
🔸Fixed an issue where the “Mount” icon would persistently be displayed under certain conditions during the main quest [Allies of the North].
🔸Fixed an issue where some servant NPCs had delayed movement during the main quest [Infiltrating the Keep].
🔸Fixed an issue where some dialogue was not displayed properly in certain side quests in the Stormlands.
🔸Fixed an issue where tutorial cutscenes would occasionally not play, preventing game progression.

[h3][b]📌 UI/UX & VISUAL[/b][/h3]
🔸Fixed an issue where certain enemy attack animations were not playing appropriately for the situation.
🔸Added an option to lower lighting effect quality in the graphics settings.
🔸Fixed an issue where some in-game text was displayed in an unintended language.
🔸Fixed an issue where the ranged attack cancel button was not visible on iOS devices.
🔸Fixed an issue where the effect for the [Violent Charge] skill was displayed even if no enemies were hit.
🔸Fixed an issue where the quantity of rewards acquired from defeating a Ferocious Beast was displayed incorrectly when receiving 2x rewards while the inventory was full.
▸ Please note that while the displayed number was incorrect, the correct amount of rewards was properly granted.
🔸Fixed an issue where the teleportation barrier would not appear during zone transitions in certain situations.
🔸Fixed an issue in Altar of Memories: Unicorn where the hands of players holding a lance were positioned awkwardly.
🔸Fixed an issue in Beyond the Wall Expedition where footprints were incorrectly placed during the blizzard stage.
🔸Fixed some awkward visual effects during the Ferocious Beast - Giant Bear encounter.
🔸Improved visibility on certain skill effects used by the Ferocious Beast - Infected Boar.
🔸Fixed an issue where certain tutorial overview entries were not displayed.
🔸Fixed an issue where Portuguese language settings would revert to an unintended language.
▸ Please note that this issue can now be fixed by downloading the new version of the game through your platform of choice after the update.
🔸Fixed an issue where owned equipment was not refreshed when entering the [Change Random Equipment Effects] menu after reforging a piece of equipment.
🔸The Emergency Escape button image has been changed for improved visibility.

We appreciate your continued support and feedback as we work to improve your experience in the game. As always, we remain committed to providing you with the best possible gameplay experience. Stay tuned for more updates, and thank you for being part of our community!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/661d50962b015bc14ff1bc13d0cadb05b0d26953.gif[/img]

Greetings, Lords and Ladies.

This is the [b]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/b] team.

As we count down to the global launch, we’re excited to bring our Early Access players a special update packed with new content.

Our May 19 update brings exciting new content and improvements to set the stage for the journey ahead:

🔹[b]New Region: The Stormlands[/b] – Explore a freshly unlocked area filled with new enemies, quests, and rewards.
🔹[b]Expanded Dungeon Challenges[/b] – Additional difficulty levels have been added across multiple dungeons—push your limits and reap the rewards.

To celebrate the upcoming official launch, we’ve also prepared a series of in-game events for everyone to enjoy.
We've also made several bug fixes and quality-of-life updates, many of which came directly from your feedback.

Check out the full patch notes below for all the details—and thank you for being part of the adventure from the very beginning.

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3183280/view/591771368562885883]1️⃣ [New Content][/url][/b]
[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3183280/view/591771368562885883]2️⃣ [Balance Adjustments][/url][/b]
[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3183280/view/591771368562885883]3️⃣ [Improvements & Changes][/url][/b]
[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3183280/view/591771368562885883]4️⃣ [New Events][/url][/b]
[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3183280/view/591771368562885883]5️⃣ [Shop][/url][/b]
[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3183280/view/591771368562885883]6️⃣ [Bug Fixes][/url][/b]

[b] ▸ Click on each section to navigate to the corresponding content.[/b]

 
[h2][b]🛡️ NEW CONTENT[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]⚔️ New Region: The Stormlands[/b][/h3]
🔹 The Stormlands have been added as a new explorable region.
🔹 New main story and side quests tied to the Stormlands are now available.
🔹 New content within the Stormlands include:
✔️ Ferocious Beast
✔️ Bandit Camps
✔️ Echoes of the Past
✔️ Historic Sites
✔️ Occupied Sites
✔️ Gods Haven
🔹 The Stormlands Token Exchange Shop has been added.
🔹 Exploration Gauge rewards are now available for the Stormlands.
🔹 11 new House Sigils have been added, specific to the Stormlands region.
🔹 2 New House Sigil Advancement boards have been added.
✔️ [Symmetry] House Sigil Advancement Board ➜ Available at the Stormlands Regional Currency Exchange Shop.
✔️ [Crown] House Sigil Advancement Board ➜ Available as a reward from the [Lord’s Virtue] event.
🔹 A new concoction [Herb Tea of Focus] and a new draught [Onslaught Draught] have been added.
🔹 With the addition of new Lost Letter collectibles in the Stormlands, new products have been added to the Tribute Exchange Shop accordingly.
🔹 Additional inventory expansion tools can be obtained in the Stormlands, allowing further inventory expansion.
✔️ Basic Inventory and Equipment Inventory available expansion limits have been increased by 1 stage. (Max: Stage 6 ➜ Stage 7)
✔️ HP Tincture max capacity expansion limits have been increased by 1 stage. (Max: Stage 4 ➜ Stage 5)

[h3][b]⚔️ Expanded Content Levels[/b][/h3]
🔹 Wormwalks has been expanded to Stage 40.
🔹 Beyond the Wall has been expanded to Stage 4.
🔹 A new Altar of Memories dungeon [Stormshower Plains Stormhorn Unicorn] has been added.

[h3][b]⚔️ Max Level Cap Expansion & New Equipment Tier[/b][/h3]
🔹 The level cap has been raised from 40 to 45.
✔️ The level requirement for certain achievements, previously set at level 50, have been lowered to level 45.
🔹 New achievements related to Momentum have been added.
🔹 With the addition of Tier 5 equipment, a new Set Collection is now available.
🔹 The maximum level of the Renan’s Rest Forge has been increased from Level 6 to Level 7 to accommodate the new equipment tier.
✔️ Upon reaching Estate Level 21, players can upgrade their Forge to Level 7, unlocking the ability to craft Tier 5 equipment.

[h3][b]⚔️ New Artifacts[/b][/h3]
🔹 Four new Artifacts have been added.
✔️ (1 Legendary, 1 Epic, 2 Uncommon)
✔️ The new Artifacts can be acquired from Artifact Expeditions.

[h3][b]⚔️ Emotes[/b][/h3]
🔹The emote system has been added.
▸ You can access emotes by selecting the emotes icon in the lower right corner of the chat window.
 
[h3][b]⚔️ Other New Additions[/b][/h3]
🔹 New achievements have been added, in relation to the Stormlands, the Unicorn, and Drogon.
🔹 Set Research levels have been expanded. (40 ➜ 45)
🔹 A Stage 5 Exploration Gauge reward has been added for the Gift.


[h2][b]⚖️ BALANCE ADJUSTMENTS[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]⚜️ General[/b][/h3]
🔸 The maximum limit for natural HP regeneration when not in combat has been adjusted. (40% ➜ 100%)
🔸 The interval for natural HP regeneration when not in combat has been adjusted. (Every 3 seconds after transitioning to a non-combat state ➜ Every 1.2 seconds after transitioning to a non-combat state)
🔸 HP Tincture effectiveness has been increased. (35% of Max HP ➜ 40% of Max HP)
🔸 [Quick Dodge] now consumes fewer dodge stacks upon use. (2 stacks ➜ 1 stack)
🔸 The recovery time for dodge stacks has been adjusted. (Recovers 1 stack every 7.5 seconds ➜ 5 seconds)
🔸 The base amount of HP Tinctures you can carry has been increased. (4 ➜ 6)
🔸 The base amount of projectiles you can carry has been increased. (4 ➜ 6)
🔸 Interacting with HP Tincture Supply Chests in the field now grants an immediate HP recovery effect.
🔸 Additional spawn locations for HP Tincture Supply Chests have been added in the field.

[h3][b]⚜️ Sellsword[/b][/h3]
🔸 The duration of the [Destruction] effect has been increased. (10 seconds ➜ 12 seconds)
🔸 The Destruction effect now grants an additional attack speed increase while active. (Upon applying Destruction, gain +5% attack speed for 8 seconds)
🔸 The targeting logic for the [Violent Charge] skill has been improved.

[h3][b]⚜️ Knight[/b][/h3]
🔸 The amount of Valor stacks required to convert to [Fighting Spirit] have been reduced. (8 ➜ 6)
🔸 The Rage consumption decrease rate per Valor stack has been adjusted. (1.5% ➜ 2%)

[h3][b]⚜️ Assassin[/b][/h3]
🔸 The maximum stack count for Bloodburst has been adjusted. (12 ➜ 8)
🔸 The damage per Bloodburst stack has been adjusted. (3,000 - 36,000 ➜ 4,500 - 36,000)
🔸 The Refinement Effects for the Artifact [Rhaegar's Ruby] have been changed to reflect the maximum Bloodburst stack adjustment.
✔️ Refinement Effect 5: Daze damage per Bloodburst stack has been changed.
✔️ Refinement Effect 7: The increase in damage taken per Bloodburst stack has been changed. (2.5 ➜ 4)
🔸 The damage dealt by the poison debuff applied by the [Poison] skill has been decreased. (Minimum damage 8,000 ➜ 5,500)
🔸 An effect that increases Daze damage taken by poisoned enemies has been added. (4% increase, up to 5 stacks)

[h3][b]⚜️ Traits[/b][/h3]

[b]🔸Ferocious Strike[/b]
✔️ Strike Combo damage has been adjusted. (15% ➜ 12%)
✔️ The Attack Power increase and duration gained upon landing a Strike Combo have been adjusted. (1.5% ➜ 1.8%, 15 seconds ➜ 5 seconds)
✔️ The Life Steal rate applied at maximum stacks has been adjusted. (5% ➜ 1.2%)

[b]🔸 Heat of the Battlefield[/b]
✔️ The damage increase for Rage consuming skills has been adjusted. (12.5% ➜ 15%)
✔️ The Rage Recovery during combat has been adjusted. (1 per second ➜ 3 per second)

[b]🔸 Endless Battle[/b]
✔️ Critical Strike Damage has been increased. (15% ➜ 17.5%)
✔️ The Critical Strike Rate gained for 5 seconds upon landing an attack has been increased. (1% ➜ 1.5%)
✔️ The additional Critical Strike Damage gained at maximum stacks has been increased. (20% ➜ 25%)

[h3][b]⚜️ Draughts[/b][/h3]
🔸 The Critical Strike Damage Increase value of the [Force Draught] has been adjusted. (100% ➜ 35%)
🔸 The damage increase against Human enemies and damage reduction from Human enemies provided by the [Executioner's Venom Ointment] have been adjusted. (30% ➜ 8%)
🔸 The damage increase against Beast enemies and damage reduction from Beast enemies provided by the [Beast Venom Ointment] have been adjusted. (30% ➜ 8%)
🔸 The damage increase against Wight enemies and damage reduction from Wight enemies provided by the [Obsidian Venom Ointment] have been adjusted. (30% ➜ 8%)
🔸 The duration of concoctions has been increased (5 minutes ➜ 30 minutes). Accordingly, their crafting recipes and vendor prices have been adjusted.
🔸 The cooldown after using a concoction has been reduced. ( 30 minutes ➜ 5 minutes)
 

[h2][b]📜 IMPROVEMENTS & CHANGES[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]🗡️ General[/b][/h3]
🔹 The Pathfinding feature is now available on PC.
🔹Certain areas within Castle Black and Last Hearth have been converted to multi-instance zones.
🔹 Only the highest-level character within an account will now be displayed for overall class Momentum/Level rankings.
🔹 New signposts have been added, and the locations of some existing signposts have been adjusted.
🔹 The clear time ranking rewards for Altar of Memories and Beyond the Wall Expedition will now be partially increased based on the difficulty level.
✔️ While rewards for lower-tier rankings have been decreased, the highest rewards have been increased.
🔹 The [Spend RP] daily mission requirement has been reduced from 120 to 80.
🔹 A new Path Display feature has been added, that visually shows your movement route when setting a destination.
✔️ This feature is available on both PC and mobile and can be toggled on/off in the game options. 
✔️ Please note that this feature is currently in Beta, and some display functions may not fully be optimized yet.

[h3][b]🗡️ Currency[/b][/h3]

[h3][b]🏹 Copper[/b][/h3]
🔹 The amount of Copper acquired from completing repeatable content has been increased.
✔️ The amount of Copper obtainable as rewards for weekly mission stages has been increased, and some rewards have been changed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/83b0106775b2f3338c7749d96c298072dc9805b2.jpg[/img]

✔️ Copper rewards for Bandit Camps, Enemy Hideouts, Ferocious Beasts, Echoes of the Past, Altars of Memories, and Beyond the Wall Expeditions have been increased.
✔️ Enemy Hideout reward chests now have a chance to drop equipment fragments.
✔️ Copper rewards from Enemy Hideout reward chests have been increased.
🔹 The amount of Copper obtained from selling Rare Jewelry has been increased.
🔹 Characters below level 14 can now revive without any cost.
🔹 All common goods icons now display a Copper mark.
🔹 Items marked with the Copper icon will be included when using the [Sell Goods] feature at merchants and are meant to be sold for Copper. 

[h3] [b]🗡️  Ferocious Beasts[/b][/h3]
🔹 [Pelt Scrap] items can now be obtained upon defeating a Ferocious Beast.
✔️ Upon defeating Ferocious Beasts, you now have a chance to obtain one of the following: Intact Pelt Scrap, Good-quality Pelt Scrap, Intact Pelt, Good-quality Pelt.
✔️ Intact/Good-quality Pelt Scraps can be exchanged for Intact/Good-quality Pelt items with Ferocious Beast Maesters.

[h3][b]🗡️  Production[/b][/h3]
🔹 Worker production abilities have been changed.
🔹 The cost per production cycle for workers has been reduced, and their rewards have been increased. (Also  applies to workers that are already currently hired)
🔹 The production items for some workers have been changed.
🔹 The number of available worker slots has been increased based on your Manor Management Office level.

[h3][b]🗡️ Trade[/b][/h3]
🔹 New trade offers are now available, replacing all previous ones.
🔹 With the exception of Whale Oil, trade goods will no longer be used as items you offer in trades. Instead, they can now be sold for Copper.
🔹 The amount of Copper obtained when selling all trade goods at merchants has been significantly increased.
🔹 Any original trade goods you possessed have been converted into common goods items.
✔️ We recommend selling these items, as they no longer have any use other than being sold.
🔹 New items [Candlesticks] and existing common goods items from Artifact Expeditions such as [Silver Spoon] and [Porcelain Doll], along with common goods from Ferocious Beasts, will now appear as trade items.
🔹  Trade slots will now be provided it at lower Manor Management Office levels.

[h3][b] 🗡️  Artifacts[/b][/h3]
🔹 Legendary Artifacts are now guaranteed from Expeditions after a certain number of attempts.
✔️ The Artifact Expedition UI will now display the "Legendary Artifact Drop Rate" instead of "Incredible Expedition" chances. (While this number might appear lower than the previous "Incredible Expedition” chances, which included Legendary + Epic Artifacts, the actual overall chance of acquiring Legendary Artifacts has been slightly increased.)
✔️ As the guaranteed expedition result has been adjusted from Epic - Legendary to a guaranteed Legendary, the way worker stats boost artifact acquisition rates has been rebalanced.
🔹 Overall chances of obtaining Epic to Legendary Artifacts during Artifact Expeditions has been increased.
✔️ The increase is even more significant for lower Expedition levels.
🔹 The number of required Expeditions for a guaranteed Artifact Expedition has been reduced.
🔹 The number of required Expeditions to level up your Artifact Expeditions at lower levels has been reduced.
🔹 The sell price of common goods items obtained as Artifact Expedition rewards has been increased. (This includes Abandoned Tools, Silver Spoons, and Porcelain Dolls.)

[h3][b]📢 Retroactive Adjustment for Guaranteed Rewards[/b][/h3]
🔹 Since the required number of Expeditions for guaranteed Legendary Artifact rewards is reduced, any excess progress you've already made will be applied retroactively.
🔹For example:
✔️ Previously, the guaranteed reward required 120 Expeditions, for which you had already completed 110 Expeditions (10 remaining)
✔️ After the update, the requirement is reduced to 90.
🔹Your progress is now shown as -20 remaining, since you’ve already exceeded the new requirement.
🔹Once you run just one more Expedition, you will immediately receive the guaranteed reward.
🔹After receiving the reward, your counter continues from the surplus you had—20 extra + 1 new run = 21 completed toward the next guaranteed drop (which now requires 90 again), so your new remaining count will be 69.

[h3][b]✅ No progress is lost in this change.[/b][/h3]
Please note that while the remaining count may appear negative in some cases, this is a visual side effect of preserving your extra progress—it does not mean you are missing out on any rewards.

We appreciate your understanding!

[h3][b]🗡️ Combat[/b][/h3]
🔹 The difficulty in combat and certain quests in early-game areas has been adjusted.
🔹 The difficulty of some bosses encountered during the main questline has been reduced.
🔹 Mounts will no longer be visible upon entering Echoes of the Past.
🔹 Certain enemies in the Dreadfort region now drop consumables upon defeat.
🔹 The Beyond the Expedition buff has been reduced from 5 stages to 3 stages, and the effect of each stage has been adjusted accordingly.
 

[b][h3][b]🎊 NEW EVENTS[/b][/h3]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/3183280/announcements/detail/591771368562885858][Go to Events][/url][/b]

[h3][b]🛒 SHOP[/b][/h3]
🔸 New items have been added. Please check the in-game shop for more details.
🔸 11 new Stormland House Sigils have been added to the Uncommon - Epic Sigil Box.
✔️ Purchase limits for House Sigil Box Bundles have been reset.
🔸 Stormlands House Sigils have been added to the item pool of Random House Sigil Boxes purchaseable from the exchange shop.
✔️ Purchase limits for the items in question have also been reset.
🔸 New Epic Artifacts have been added to the Epic Artifact Selection Box.
✔️ Purchase limits for the box in question have been reset, and the purchase count has been changed from 2 to 1.
🔸 The Rare - Legendary Jewelry Box has been removed from the Royal Favor Exchange Shop, and the Uncommon - Epic Jewelry Box / Epic - Legendary Jewelry Box have been added instead.
🔸 The conditions and durations of some conditional pop-up products have been adjusted.
✔️ Some packs may reappear, and they will be available for repurchase even if you previously purchased them.
🔸 [Crude Equipment Fragment] items have been added to the Alliance Shop.
🔸 The maximum purchase period for House Tyre Monthly Subscription has been changed from 5 years to 3 years.
✔️  If you have already purchased it beyond 3 years, your purchase duration will remain unchanged.
🔸 With the addition of a new equipment tier, relevant items have been added to various exchange shops:
✔️ Alliance Token Exchange Shop: Added Exceptional Equipment Fragments
✔️ North/Reach Regional Currency Exchange Shop: Added Exceptional Equipment Selection Box
🔸 The price of Rare Jewelry (Random) in the North/Reach Regional Currency Exchange Shop has been adjusted.

[h2][b]🛠️ FIXES & IMPROVEMENTS[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]⚜️ General[/b][/h3]
🔸 Backend server optimizations have been implemented to improve overall stability.

[h3][b]⚜️ Combat & Gameplay[/b][/h3]
🔸 When using the [Ignite Weapon+] and [Poison+] skills, nearby enemies will now be hitstunned.
🔸 A feature to individually reset Skill Mastery nodes has been added.

🔸 Certain pathfinding routes have been adjusted.
🔸 The remaining stamina recovery time for hired workers is now displayed, and workers will now recover stamina even if rewards from Production/Trade/Artifact Expedition tasks have not been collected.
🔸 The respawn cycle of some equipment chests in the field have been adjusted.
🔸 Fixed an issue where mounts couldn’t be unmounted in under certain conditions.
🔸 Fixed an issue where some equipment set effects were occasionally not applied correctly.
🔸 Hunters near Ferocious Beasts now only craft bait specific to each beast.
🔸 The Assassin class’ control movement has been improved.
🔸 Using a Legendary Active Artifact skill will now also stun nearby enemies.

🔸 Fixed an issue where the Peddler notification would sometimes indicate a different location than their actual position.
🔸 Fixed some awkward appearances or animations of certain NPCs.
🔸 Fixed an issue where the screen would flicker when teleporting during main quest progression.
🔸 Fixed an issue where the quest objective marker would flicker.
🔸 Fixed an issue where mount speed was restricted under certain situations during some quests.
🔸 The reward acquisition methods for some quests have been changed.
🔸 Fixed an issue where items with no remaining duration were not being removed from the Scavenger’s reward list.

notes.title: Game of Thrones: Kingsroad Official Release FAQ
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/b12f21ba30e92bbd6503cb8c881325f8f31f2348.gif[/img]

Greetings, Lords and Ladies.
This is the [b]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/b] team.

The wait is almost over! We are thrilled to reveal that the official launch date for Game of Thrones: Kingsroad is scheduled for [b]May 21st, 2025 (PT)[/b]. 

We extend our deepest gratitude for everyone who has been eagerly awaiting this moment for your patience and unwavering support. We appreciate your continued excitement as we move into the final preparations for you to officially experience the realm.

[h3][b] 1. Available Platforms Upon Official Release
[/b][/h3]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad will be launching on both mobile and PC.
On mobile, the game will be available through the Apple App Store and Google Play Store.
On PC, it can be accessed via Steam, Google Play Games, our dedicated PC launcher, and the Epic Games Store.
Additionally, Game of Thrones: Kingsroad supports cross-play, allowing you to enjoy the same character across both mobile and PC platforms—so you can continue your adventure anytime, anywhere.

[h3][b]2. Available Regions Upon Official Release
[/b][/h3]At launch, the game will be available in approximately 200 countries across North America, South America, Europe, Oceania, and the MENA region.
However, please note that service in Asia will open at a later date due to additional localization work, as previously announced. https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3183280/view/537722458840499318

We will provide further updates once the launch schedule for Asia is confirmed.

[h3][b]3. Gameplay Data
[/b][/h3]Currently, the game is available through Steam Early Access and limited Open Beta Testing (OBT) in select regions. 
Please note that any progress made during Early Access will not be reset at launch. You can continue your adventure and experience the newly added content using your existing character after the official release. 

[h3][b]4. Post-Launch Content 
[/b][/h3]After the official release, new areas and main episodes will be added, along with additional content like new Altar of Memories dungeons.
We’ll be sharing further details about upcoming content through future Developer Notes—so stay tuned!

[h3][b]5. Bridging the Gap Between Early Access and New Players
[/b][/h3]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad is fundamentally designed with a focus on single-player gameplay, and we are working to minimize any feelings of imbalance or unfairness that might arise from differences in progression. 
Above all, we have undergone extensive testing, including Open Beta Testing (OBT), to improve the game and make it more enjoyable and accessible for everyone. We encourage all players to focus on the inherent fun of progressing through the later stages and reaching the endgame content, rather than comparing progress with other characters. 

[h3][b]6. AMA Schedule and Future Improvements
[/b][/h3]We have been receiving a lot of valuable feedback and suggestions from players, and we’re truly grateful for all the input. We have been carefully reviewing the questions submitted through our official Discord in preparation for our upcoming AMA session in May. The AMA will take place on May 8th (PT), through which we will address questions that have been asked and engage in a broader discussion on topics of interest within the community. 
Make sure to be on the lookout for a separate announcement containing detailed information regarding the AMA schedule, participation channel, and instructions on how to join. 

[h3][b]7. Special Rewards for Steam Early Access Players
[/b][/h3]We would like to extend a heartfelt thank you to each and every one of you who joined our Steam Early Access. Your incredible enthusiasm and the insightful feedback you’ve provided have been invaluable in shaping the game’s development. 
As a token of our sincere appreciation, we have prepared a special reward exclusively for our Steam Early Access participations. 
Upon our official release, all Steam Early Access players will receive two unique items: an exclusive outfit and a distinctive House Sigil. 
Anyone who purchases the Steam Early Access before the official release will be eligible for these rewards. We will share details regarding their distribution in a future announcement closer to the release date.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/74c1c72b5bb6c5623fb6b4f818a7d78dd5691ab2.png[/img]

Our development team is dedicated to delivering an incredible adventure across the continent of Westeros, and we strive to incorporate as much of your valuable feedback as possible.
We recognize that our prior communication regarding patches may have been somewhat lacking, and we sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused. Moving forward, we are committed to more frequent and transparent communication through regular AMA sessions and Developer Notes.

Greetings, Lords and Ladies. 
This is the [b]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/b] team.

This update includes skill balance adjustments and fixes for ongoing issues within the game. Be sure to check the patch notes below and enjoy your adventure!

We always appreciate your feedback and are committed to continually improving your experience in [i]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/i].

[h2][b]■ BALANCE ADJUSTMENTS 
[/b][/h2]
The duration of Ignite and Poison Weapon skills was previously shorter than their cooldowns, making it difficult to maintain their buffs consistently. This created challenges in content such as Beyond the Wall Expeditions, particularly when fighting Wight enemies or trying to sustain a poison-based attack tempo.

To resolve this, we are extending the duration of these buffs while reducing their cooldown times.

➤ The duration and cooldown of the Ignite Weapon skill for Knight, Assassin, and Sellsword classes have been adjusted.
• Duration: 15 seconds ➜ 20 seconds
• Cooldown: 24 seconds ➜ 20 seconds

➤ The duration and cooldown of the Ignite Weapon+ skill for Knight, Assassin and Sellsword classes have been adjusted.
• Duration: 20 seconds ➜ 30 seconds
• Cooldown: 24 seconds ➜ 20 seconds

➤ The duration of the Poison and Poison+ skills for the Assassin class have been adjusted.
• Duration: 15 seconds ➜ 20 seconds

➤ The maximum projectile recovery rate has been fixed to 65%.

[h2][b]■ IMPROVEMENTS
[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]📌 Currency
[/b][/h3]
We’ve made several adjustments to address some feedback around Copper scarcity and the high cost of using HP Tinctures during gameplay.

➤ The number of Sweetgrass required to craft HP Tinctures has been reduced from 8 → 4, making them easier to produce and the materials easier to acquire.
➤ The cost of Copper per Alliance donation has been reduced from 5,000 → 3,000.
* Rewards per donation will remain unchanged.
➤ Due to the lowered donation cost, the amount of Copper received from exchanging Alliance Tokens has been adjusted from 6,000 → 4,500.
➤ The cost to purchase HP Tinctures upon revival in Altar of Memories dungeons has been reduced from 1,000 → 500 in order to support smoother multiplayer gameplay.
➤ The Copper earned from clearing Bandit Camps has been increased by 1.6x.
* The RP cost and other rewards will remain unchanged.
➤ Both the entry fee and rewards for minigames have been reduced to better align with overall balance.
➤ The fast travel fees for Renan’s Rest and Renan’s Rest Main Hall have been removed. It is now completely free to travel to these locations.

[h3][b]📌 Combat
[/b][/h3]
➤ The knockback effect from the skill combo used by two-handed sword Elite Enemies has been removed.
➤ All classes can now apply a hitstun effect to enemies when using Sprint Attack (Heavy).

[h3][b]📌 Other
[/b][/h3]
➤ Crafting time for all types of bait has been reduced from 5 seconds → instant (0 seconds).
➤ The number of available worker employment slots depending on your Manor Management Office level have been increased.
➤ The treasure chest in a Bandit Camp in Highergarden can now be opened without a key.
* Treasure Chest Keys currently in possession can now be sold or discarded.
➤ Access to the shop, Battle Pass, and Equipment management content is now unlocked right after completing the “Winter is Coming” quest.

[h2][b]■ BUG FIXES
[/b][/h2]
 
[h3][b]📌 General Fixes
[/b][/h3]
➤ Backend server optimizations have been implemented to improve overall stability.

[h3][b]📌 Shop Fixes

* If the rewards still cannot be claimed after the update, please try fully closing and restarting the game in order to claim the rewards.
➤ Fixed an issue where certain items in the Reach Token Shop could be exchanged for North Tokens.

[/b][/h3]
➤ Fixed an issue where Super Armor was not being applied while using Merciless Strike+.
➤ Fixed an issue where Quick Dodge could not remove the stun effect caused by the Giant Wight’s Roar skill during Echoes of the Past.
➤ Fixed an issue in the Cockatrices of the Shores of Dorne dungeon in Altar of Memories where the attacks from one of Red Cockatrice’s skills could not be avoided.
➤ Fixed an issue where destroying the lock on a double ladder with a ranged attack within Bandit Camps failed to lower the ladder.
➤ Fixed an issue where some bounty targets could not be attacked under certain conditions.
➤ Fixed an issue where the screen occasionally turned white during an Artifact Expedition.
➤ Some rewards obtainable from certain Enemy Hideouts have been changed.
➤ Fixed an issue where forcibly exiting from a Beyond the Wall Expedition prevented players from continuing the expedition afterward.
➤ Fixed an issue where rewards from Bandit Camps could be repeatedly claimed under certain conditions.

[h3][b]📌 Quest & NPC Fixes
[/b][/h3]
➤ Fixed an issue where NPCs occasionally wouldn’t move during the main quest [Infiltrating the Keep].
➤ Fixed an issue where some rewards couldn’t be claimed during the tutorial encounters, and corrected the positioning of certain NPCs.
➤ Fixed an issue preventing certain encounters in Oldtown from progressing.
➤ Fixed an issue where enemy stats in some Occupied Sites were abnormally low.
➤ Added markers to show the location of targets during certain bounty quests.

➤ Fixed an issue where it was possible to move through inaccessible areas.

➤ Fixed an issue where interacting with doors in certain situations would prevent movement and make the character uncontrollable.

For those [b]who have already purchased a Founder’s Pack that includes the previous outfits, we’ll be sending you two outfit selection boxes for the outfits you purchased soon[/b].
